summary: Viewed the four supplied PNGs at native 1x and their nearest-neighbor 3x previews. The oversized golden straw hat, shoulder tufts, brown body, small dark eye and red waist cord form a recognizable, consistently right-facing creature. Broad light planes on the upper-left hat/shoulder and darker lower/right planes give readable volume; straw detail is restrained, with the body reading somewhat like bundled wood. No conspicuous accidental interior transparency, broken body contours or detached hand/tool is visible across the three backgrounds. Standing soles share the ground line; the low dead silhouette and folded sleep legs remain connected. Windup gathers the grain hand behind the torso, move/attack widen the stance and extend the connected tool, recover retracts it, and hit leans back distinctly. Skill preparation brightens the actual grain tip; the release shows three gold grain heads with trails originating at the raised stalk, followed by a lowered hand and separated grains. Poison bends the body with purple motes, stun drops the tool with overhead stars, and sleep kneels with a closed horizontal eyelid; these are authored pose changes, not whole-sprite tints. Idle and paired status changes are subtle but coherent in the static comparisons. This is a visual keep recommendation, not a user selection or geometry-based approval. Static pose previews cannot establish animated timing, actual battle readability, runtime hop behavior or literal palette-index authorship.
